subject: eng
title: Grammar 6A Ch 6: Similes (as ... as / be ... like) & Connectives (however / but)

questions.q: The princess's skin is ___ white ___ snow.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.23：明喻結構 as + 形容詞 + as（as white as snow 雪白）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: The princess's skin is ___ white ___ snow.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 6: Similes (as ... as / be ... like) & Connectives (however / but)

questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.28 Section D Q1：as proud as a peacock（像孔雀一樣驕傲），不可寫 proud like a peacock。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Sam is ___ proud ___ a peacock.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 6: Similes (as ... as / be ... like) & Connectives (however / but)

questions.q: The firefighter is brave ___ a lion.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.23–24：be + 形容詞 + like + 名詞（brave like a lion 像獅子一樣勇敢）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: The firefighter is brave ___ a lion.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 6: Similes (as ... as / be ... like) & Connectives (however / but)

questions.q: After the teacher explained the rule, everything is clear ___ crystal now.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.28 Section D Q8：這裏的 like 是介詞（「像水晶一樣清晰」），不可加 -s 寫成 likes。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: After the teacher explained the rule, everything is clear ___ crystal now.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 6: Similes (as ... as / be ... like) & Connectives (however / but)

questions.q: Grandpa is seventy years old, ___ he is still as strong as an ox.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.25 & p.28：在同一個句子中間連接兩個轉折分句（前面只有逗號，後無逗號），用連接詞 but。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Grandpa is seventy years old, ___ he is still as strong as an ox.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 6: Similes (as ... as / be ... like) & Connectives (however / but)

questions.q: Bob is very smart. ___, he is proud and rude to his classmates.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.25 & p.28 Section D Q5：放在第二句句首並有逗號隔開，表示「然而／可是」用 However,。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Bob is very smart. ___, he is proud and rude to his classmates.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 6: Similes (as ... as / be ... like) & Connectives (however / but)

questions.q: Complete the simile (Grammar 6A p.23): The old man is as wise as an ___.
questions.explain: 固定比喻搭配：as wise as an owl（像貓頭鷹一樣有智慧）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Complete the simile (Grammar 6A p.23): The old man is as wise as an ___.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 6: Similes (as ... as / be ... like) & Connectives (however / but)

questions.q: In 'The pillows are as soft as clouds', 'as ... as' is used to compare two things that are similar.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.23，我們用 as ... as 和 be ... like 來作比喻（similes）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: In 'The pillows are as soft as clouds', 'as ... as' is used to compare two things that are similar.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 6: Similes (as ... as / be ... like) & Connectives (however / but)
